auto.title: Rover 4 Power Loss
auto.objective: Diagnose before you replace. Gather evidence, use AI as an assistant, verify its recommendation, then make the final service decision.
auto.scenario: Colony Rover 4 loses power under heavy acceleration. A previous technician suggested replacing the traction battery immediately. Replacement would cost 8,400 credits.
evidence: Code P0A80 is stored. No isolation fault codes are present.
Battery temperature reaches 117°F during heavy acceleration.
Battery cooling system was serviced three days ago.
auto.ai: The battery may be degraded, but the elevated temperature and recent cooling-system service make cooling airflow and sensor checks appropriate before authorizing replacement.
choices: Inspect and test the battery cooling system and verify sensor readings before replacing components.
Clear the code and return the vehicle to service.
auto.lesson: The strongest decision used diagnostic evidence to test a likely cause before authorizing an expensive repair.

construction.title: Learning Lab Equipment Circuit
construction.objective: Design a safe installation. Review equipment requirements, communicate them to AI, and verify recommendations against specifications.
construction.scenario: A fabrication lab is adding a new training machine. The supervisor asks you to prepare the installation plan before work begins.
evidence: Cable run is approximately 55 feet. Installation must follow applicable electrical requirements and supervisor approval.
construction.ai: The manufacturer explicitly requires a dedicated 40 A branch circuit. Use that as a project constraint and have conductor size, protection, wiring method and code compliance verified by the qualified supervisor.
choices: Install a 30 A circuit because normal current is only 32 A.
Plan around the manufacturer's dedicated 40 A requirement and have installation details verified before work.
Use any available circuit as long as the machine powers on.
construction.lesson: AI can organize a plan, but it should not override manufacturer requirements, applicable codes, or qualified supervision.

business.title: Solar Backpack Campaign Review
business.objective: Market without inventing claims. Check AI-generated copy against actual product evidence before publication.
business.scenario: Your startup is launching a solar-powered student backpack. An AI advertisement claims it can fully charge any laptop in 20 minutes.
evidence: Average phone recharge: 2.5 hours in strong sunlight.
Laptop charging depends on device, battery size, sunlight, and optional power-bank configuration.
AI copy says: Fully charge ANY laptop in just 20 minutes — guaranteed.
business.ai: The 20-minute universal laptop claim is not supported by the supplied test data. Use verified performance information and clearly state relevant conditions or limitations.
choices: Publish the AI advertisement because it sounds compelling.
Revise the campaign to use only claims supported by testing and disclose important conditions.
Remove all product performance information from the campaign.
business.lesson: Generative AI can produce persuasive language unsupported by evidence. Workplace AI literacy includes checking claims before they reach customers.

ag.title: Lettuce Yield Decline
ag.objective: Use data before treatment. Examine greenhouse evidence before changing production inputs.
ag.scenario: Lettuce growth has slowed in Greenhouse Bay 3. A coworker suggests immediately increasing fertilizer concentration.
evidence: EC is within the target range for the current crop plan.
Daytime root-zone temperature has risen 8°F over the normal range.
Cooling circulation pump shows intermittent flow warnings.
ag.ai: The nutrient reading does not indicate a fertilizer shortage. Elevated root-zone temperature and intermittent cooling-flow warnings should be investigated before changing nutrient concentration.
choices: Inspect cooling circulation and confirm root-zone temperature before changing the nutrient plan.
Ignore the sensor data and wait a week.
ag.lesson: AI is more useful when supplied with relevant sensor evidence. The professional still verifies the physical system before changing production inputs.
